g.title: AlignmentFrameRelations
g.text: Alignment criteria: specialization, encoding, limits, and conflict
Solid specializes · Dashed projects · Dotted encodes · Bold isomorphic summand · Blue limit · Purple stronger quantifier · Green composable
Incompatible: red solid rigid · red dashed choice conflict · red dotted not representable · orange shared resource
